Sheroanawe Hakihiiwe Opening

Type
Opening Night
Date
Thu, Nov 19, 2026
7–9 PM
Location
ICA Miami
RSVP
RSVP

ICA Miami, in collaboration with the Fondation Cartier pour l’art contemporain, presents an exclusive look at a landmark exhibition celebrating the work of Sheroanawe Hakihiiwe, whose work reflects expressions of Amazonia and Yanomami heritage.
